text: A Psalm. A song for the dedication of the temple. Of David (beloved). 1 I will exalt You, O LORD {YHWH}, for You have lifted me up and have not allowed my foes to rejoice over me.
O LORD my God {YHWH Elohay}, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.
O LORD {YHWH}, You pulled me up from Sheol; You spared me from descending into the Pit.
Sing to the LORD {YHWH}, O you His saints, and praise His holy name (and praise the memorial of His holiness).
For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.
In prosperity I said, “I will never be shaken.”
O LORD {YHWH}, You favored me; You made my mountain stand strong. When You hid Your face, I was dismayed.
To You, O LORD {YHWH}, I called, and I begged my Lord for mercy:
“What gain is there in my bloodshed (in my destruction), in my descent to the Pit (to corruption)? Will the dust praise You? Will it proclaim Your faithfulness?
Hear me, O LORD {YHWH}, and have mercy; O LORD, be my helper.”
You turned my mourning into dancing; You peeled off my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,
that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent. O LORD my God {YHWH Elohay}, I will give thanks forever.
